commands.cmd: duckdb -c "COPY (SELECT range AS i, range * range AS sq FROM range(1000)) TO '${TMPDIR:?}/duckdb-receipt.parquet' (FORMAT parquet); SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(sq) AS total FROM read_parquet('${TMPDIR:?}/duckdb-receipt.parquet');" && rm -f "${TMPDIR:?}/duckdb-receipt.parquet"

claim: On host macos-m5pro-20260924 (Apple M5 Pro, 18 cores, 24 GB, macOS arm64), DuckDB 1.5.5 (the catalog pin; command -v resolves to mise's 1.5.5 install and the host's mise global config pins duckdb = "1.5.5") wrote 1,000 computed rows to a Parquet file and read them back, returning count 1000 and sum of squares 332833500, the exact expected value (all commands exit 0).
limitations: One synthetic Parquet round trip in a temporary file, removed afterwards; no persistent database file, extensions, concurrency or remote storage.
